facts.text: West Bloomfield Township is a charter township in Oakland County.
Residents sometimes call West Bloomfield the lake township of Oakland County because it is dotted with small and medium-sized lakes.
Cass Lake, the largest lake in Oakland County, lies partly within West Bloomfield, and Pine Lake lies entirely within the township.
West Bloomfield, Orchard Lake Village, Keego Harbor and Sylvan Lake together make up what is known as Greater West Bloomfield.
Orchard Lake Road runs north and south through the middle of the township and, with West Maple Road, forms its main commercial corridor lined with shopping centers.
Most of West Bloomfield's population growth has come since the 1960s, as many residents moved out from inner-ring Detroit suburbs.
The West Bloomfield Trail, a 6.8-mile former railroad corridor, runs through West Bloomfield, Orchard Lake, Keego Harbor and Sylvan Lake from Sylvan Manor Park to Haggerty Road.
The West Bloomfield Woods Nature Preserve, south of Pontiac Trail along the West Bloomfield Trail, has carpets of trillium and trout lilies under mature oak and hickory trees.
Marshbank Park on Hiller Road sits on the Cass Lake shoreline and hosts events such as a summer concert series and a Trick-or-Treat Trail.

christmas-light-installation.title: Christmas Light Installation in West Bloomfield, MI
christmas-light-installation.meta_description: West Bloomfield Christmas light installation for lakefront homes and tall trees. Bucket trucks for the high work, service all season, free estimate.
christmas-light-installation.h1: Christmas Light Installation in West Bloomfield, MI
christmas-light-installation.hero_sub: Rooflines, tall trees and shoreline views, designed for West Bloomfield homes and installed by bucket-truck crews who take it all down after the season.
christmas-light-installation.local_paragraph: A lake changes how a house should be lit. With Cass Lake, Pine Lake and a scatter of smaller lakes across the township, many West Bloomfield homes have one side facing the water and another facing the street, and both deserve a plan. On the lake side, roofline lights and shoreline trees reflect off the water and carry a long way. Big trees are the other opportunity. If your lot has mature oaks or hickories like those in the West Bloomfield Woods Nature Preserve, canopy wraps from a bucket truck can light the yard from above. Our crews handle every step, from the first walkthrough to the last strand coming down after the holidays.
considerations: Mature oaks and hickories need reach. Crews working from bucket trucks can wrap trunks and run lights up into the canopy, giving a large yard a glow you can see from the road. Every tree in the plan is named on the estimate, so you choose which ones to feature.

Subdivisions and condo communities with an association often have exterior lighting guidelines, so check yours before the season. The design can go to the board for review, and install and takedown can be scheduled around any timing the association sets.

Across open water, warm white reads calm and elegant, while multicolor feels playful from the street. You can also split the difference, with warm white on the lake side and color out front. We will talk through the look with you before anything is hung.
faq: Do you serve Orchard Lake, Keego Harbor and Sylvan Lake too?

Yes. Orchard Lake Village, Keego Harbor and Sylvan Lake are all part of Greater West Bloomfield, and all of it falls inside our Southeast Michigan service area. Your address tells us which lake or neighborhood we are planning for, so include it with the estimate request.
Is the lake side of the house part of the plan?

Yes, and it gets its own section of the design. Lake-facing eaves, deck rails and shoreline trees are planned from the water's point of view. Near the shore we account for footing, access and where power is available before settling the layout.
When should West Bloomfield homeowners book?

Early, for the most choice. Installs commonly run from October into early December, and a request made in September or October leaves more dates open than one made after Thanksgiving. Takedown follows the holidays, and your estimate spells out the full scope before anything is scheduled.

commercial-holiday-lighting.title: Commercial Holiday Lighting in West Bloomfield, MI
commercial-holiday-lighting.meta_description: West Bloomfield commercial holiday lighting for Orchard Lake Road and West Maple shopping centers, offices, condos and HOAs. Estimates are free.
commercial-holiday-lighting.h1: Commercial Holiday Lighting in West Bloomfield, MI
commercial-holiday-lighting.hero_sub: Shopping center rooflines, parking lot trees and association entrances, designed for West Bloomfield properties and installed, serviced and removed by our crews.
commercial-holiday-lighting.local_paragraph: West Bloomfield's business district follows Orchard Lake Road, which runs north and south through the middle of the township, and West Maple Road, and both are lined with shopping centers. Commercial lighting here usually starts with those centers and the trees along their parking lots. It rarely stops there. Greater West Bloomfield also takes in Orchard Lake Village, Keego Harbor and Sylvan Lake, and its subdivisions, condo communities and associations have entrances and common areas worth lighting too. Every site is designed on its own, installed with bucket trucks for the high runs, looked after through the season and cleared once the holidays pass.
considerations: One look for the whole center

Property managers along Orchard Lake Road and West Maple can light a full center under a single design. Matching rooflines, sign islands and parking lot trees makes the property feel coordinated, and tenants get a lit storefront without arranging it themselves.

An association entrance is the first thing every resident passes each evening. We light the sign, the landscape bed and a few flanking trees so the entrance reads clearly from the road, and the colors can follow whatever the board prefers.

Shopping centers stay busy through install season. We coordinate timing with the property manager, work from bucket trucks for the high runs and set up so storefronts and parking stay usable wherever the site allows.
faq: Can you light a shopping center on Orchard Lake Road or West Maple?

Yes. A center on either corridor is exactly the kind of property our commercial work covers, alongside offices, condo associations and HOAs. Share the property address and the name of whoever approves vendors, and we will shape the free estimate around your center.
Do you light the trees in the parking lot?

Yes. Trees along the lot and in the islands are often the first part of a center that drivers notice. Crews wrap trunks and main limbs from bucket trucks, and lighting a few well-placed trees near the entrances often does more than lighting every one.
Are condo communities part of your commercial work?

They are. Condo associations and subdivisions both fall under our commercial service, from entrance signs and common-area trees to clubhouse and building rooflines. Share the areas the association maintains, and the estimate will list each one with its installation, service and removal.

permanent-lighting.title: Permanent Christmas Lights in West Bloomfield, MI
permanent-lighting.meta_description: Permanent Christmas lights for West Bloomfield lake and neighborhood homes, planned for the view from the street and the water. Free estimate.
permanent-lighting.h1: Permanent Lighting in West Bloomfield, MI
permanent-lighting.hero_sub: Roofline lighting that stays up all year along the eaves of your West Bloomfield home, changed with a tap from a summer evening on the lake to the holidays.
permanent-lighting.local_paragraph: In a township full of lakes, a roofline is often seen from two directions, the street and the far shore. Permanent lighting makes that view part of every season instead of only December. The lights mount along the eaves, stay in place year-round and run from an app, so you can set a warm white accent for a summer evening on Cass Lake or Pine Lake and switch to a holiday palette when the season turns. Away from the water, many homes date from the township's growth after the 1960s, and each layout is planned to follow the house's own lines.
considerations: From a boat or a dock on the far side of the lake, a lit roofline reads as one clean line. We give the lake side a continuous outline so it carries at a distance, and the app lets you change the color to suit the night.

Mature trees near the house can overhang or crowd a roofline. Runs are planned around the limbs, and in December you can pair the permanent roofline with seasonal tree wraps for a fuller display across the whole yard.

A long ranch roof, a two-story colonial and a contemporary home with many angles each need their own layout. We choose which edges to light so the outline looks deliberate, and the estimate shows every run included.
faq: Which communities around West Bloomfield can get permanent lighting?

All of Greater West Bloomfield: the township itself plus Orchard Lake Village, Keego Harbor and Sylvan Lake, all inside our Southeast Michigan service area. Send your address and a note about when you picture using the lights, and the free estimate will lay out the scope in writing.
How is a permanent lighting estimate put together?

It starts with your roofline and maps which eaves and peaks the lights will follow, how the layout handles the lake side if you have one, and what the installation includes. You see the full scope in writing before deciding.
What about parties and summer gatherings?

They are a big part of the appeal. Set a warm white for a dinner on the deck, a team's colors for a watch party or festive colors for a birthday, all from an app on your phone, with nothing to string up beforehand.
